title: Genesis 2: A New Beginning
author: MKopelke

comments.author: No-Shirt8790
comments.body:
i gave it a shot. i think its a bit too early to really comment on much as there isn't really much a a game to play.    

what is there worked though, i could place some building and collect some resources.    

some things that i would fix based on a small test is building placement. even if you have explored an area you cant place a building unless its currently in the visible radius.    

maybe cancel placement with right click instead of needing to click a ui button.    

  
should be able to move units outside of the explored area instead of needing to keep clicking within the vision radius.

replies.author: MKopelke
replies.body:
Thanks for giving it a crack. I appreciate it. 

Yes, the fog of war system needs a lot of work.

And yes, I need a right click cancel system. And I want to add the ability to demolish buildings in case you place the wrong one, or in the wrong spot.

comments.author: Sufficient_Crew_5321
comments.body: Congratulations on getting your first playable prototype out there. Finishing and sharing a project is something many aspiring developers never reach. The colony survival concept sounds interesting, and it will be exciting to see how the research and diplomacy systems evolve over time.

replies.author: MKopelke
replies.body: Thanks! It's been fun iterating for about an hour a day before my Codex tokens expire. So while I am making a lot of progress, it's also equal-parts frustrating to have my ideas so much further along what I can do in Codex with rate limits!
